data.description:
I used this as a stationary desktop replacement and it never traveled, so the body and keyboard are in good condition. It has been wiped and clean-installed with macOS Monterey, left at the out of box setup screen. Early 2015 is the last year of the scissor switch keyboard before the butterfly generation, a common reason buyers seek out this specific model.

Model | MacBook Pro 13 inch Retina, Early 2015 (A1502, MacBookPro12,1)
Processor | Intel Core i5 2.9 GHz, the top i5 offered in this model
Memory | 8 GB

Operating System | macOS 12 Monterey, clean install, at first time setup screen
Ports | HDMI, 2x USB 3.0, SD card reader, 2x Thunderbolt 2
Included | Laptop and a third party MagSafe 2 charger

Screen | Anti reflective coating wear, commonly called staingate. Visible, not severe, does not affect use. No dead pixels.
